input.content: Pattern: flipping a default flag (e.g. DETAILED_REPORT False->True) routes all default callers onto a previously opt-in branch, exposing its latent bugs as regressions. Example: stats.summarize computed mean = sum/len without an empty guard; harmless while detailed mode was opt-in, but making it default turned report([]) from "Items: 0" into ZeroDivisionError. Tests only updated the populated default case. Review check: when a default changes, trace boundary inputs (empty, zero, None) through the newly-default branch and require tests for the default path on those inputs.
